content: OGL latest v1.0.11 (June 2026). Zero-dependency ES module WebGL library, ~5-8KB gzipped (core 8KB, full ~29KB). Provides Renderer, Camera, Transform, Geometry, Program, Mesh, Texture, RenderTarget — thin abstraction over WebGL with no material system (write your own GLSL). 4K+ GitHub stars. Ideal for shader-driven backgrounds, particle systems, post-processing where you don't need Three.js scene graph. Best when effect fits in a shader + buffer and bundle size matters.
